title: Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver Fee: Questions on the Seasoning Credit
content:
Rural Home Loans: a seasoning credit applies to the escrow waiver fee of a seasoned, well-paid loan.

## Rule

A seasoning credit applies: a loan open at least 60 months with no late charge in the 24 months up to today has 25 percent taken off; a loan open at least 24 months that in the 12 months up to today had at least twelve scheduled principal payments booked and no returned remittance, and not meeting the first test, has 10 percent taken off; any other loan has none.

## Questions and answers

**How are months open counted?** In whole months from the loan's opening date on the loan record to today, a month being completed on the same day of the month as the opening date.

**What counts as a late charge here?** A late-charge fee assessed on the home loan in the 24 months up to today, from the day after the same calendar day 24 months before today through today.

**What are scheduled principal payments booked?** Principal payment entries on the home loan applied to a monthly payment (not curtailments and not payoffs), dated in the 12 months up to today.

**What is a returned remittance?** A principal payment return entry on the home loan in the 12 months up to today.

**How does the credit act?** It is taken off once, as a percentage of the fee as it then stands — after the fee rate has been applied to the amount the fee is figured on and after any other percentage already taken off the fee — so two percentages taken off the same fee act one after the other and are never added together.

## Truth table

| Months open | Late charge in 24 months | Twelve or more scheduled principal payments in 12 months | Return in 12 months | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | none | any | any | 25 percent |
| 60 or more | one or more | yes | none | 10 percent |
| 24 to 59 | any | yes | none | 10 percent |
| 24 or more | — | no, or a return | — | none, unless the first test is met |
| fewer than 24 | any | any | any | none |

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A fee figure of 665.00 on a loan open 64 months with no late charge in 24 months: 25 percent off leaves 498.75.
